_doc: Custom draft strategies (hand-edited, same spirit as opponents.json).
Each spec is validated by engine/strategy.js validateStrategy() at load;
invalid specs are dropped with a console warning, never fatal.
A spec may ONLY contain: name, label, blurb, multipliers, constraints,
overrideDelta. That whitelist is the structural guard for the engine's
no-additive-terms rule — a strategy shapes the score multiplicatively
and constrains the shortlist; it can never add bonus points.
name          ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$, must not shadow a built-in
multipliers   {POS: [{from, to, m}]}  POS in QB/RB/WR/TE,
These specs also serve as opponent ARCHETYPES for the Monte Carlo and
reference any name here or any built-in.

strategies.name: wr_heavy
strategies.label: WR Heavy
strategies.blurb: Bank the WR tier cliff early; RB volume from the mid rounds.

strategies.name: elite_te
strategies.label: Elite TE
strategies.blurb: Pay up for a top-tier TE while the cliff is live; never a mid TE.
